sourceNote: Complete phase-local placement of catalog items with unlock conditions, plus all required Dead God collection pickups. Default availability is determined by explicit constant conditions, never by tier rank or secret flags. Phase placement and letter ranks are editorial priorities, not official item quality or mandatory phase conditions. Exact unlock rules and their sources remain in the shared catalog.

mom.description: Early boss rewards, first donations and optional foundations on the way to Mom.

heart.description: Heart milestones, accessible challenges and useful goals for your first repeated runs.

photographs.description: Isaac and Satan rewards to pursue while earning both photographs.

hush.description: Hush rewards to pursue while opening the alternate path. Later character rewards follow their own chapters.

mother.description: Regular-character Mother rewards and special unlocks along the alternate path.

beast.description: Home discoveries and Beast rewards, including your first Tainted-character targets.

routes.description: Chest, Dark Room, Boss Rush and Void rewards, plus return trips with later characters.

marks.description: Full-mark rewards and multi-route Tainted-character goals, including return trips to Mother.

conditions.description: Remaining challenges, daily runs and special or long-term unlock conditions.

dead-god.description: Every required collection pickup, including items available from the start. Hide obtained items to focus on what this slot still needs.

greed.description: All Greed rewards and early donation unlocks. Character and route requirements remain visible on each item.

greedier.description: All Greedier rewards and the later donation milestone, ranked independently within this branch.

lost.description: All Lost item rewards, across his routes and the full Hard / Greedier page.

keeper.description: All Keeper and Tainted Keeper item rewards, across both the story routes and Greed modes.
